usage.summary:
Implemented configured trust, base revalidation, draft holds, workflow-permission handoffs, and docs/regressions.

Final checks fail only the six recovered-draft cases in `TestConfiguredPublicationKeepsTrustedDrafts695`. They require updating an existing empty PR body, but the GitHub interface lacks that operation and its client/fake are outside the allowed files. This needs a revised plan; acceptance tests remain unchanged.

The merger must also record this step’s decision before proceeding.
